data.raw_text:
Para po? Para Kay Colet! 

"Meron pa pala kaming uuwian..." - Colet

Mula simula hanggang sa makarating sa kasalukuyan, malugod at buong puso po nagpapa-salamat ang Team Colet sa lahat ng tumulong upang maging sakses! lahat ng proyekto na inihanda namin para sa pagbabalik ng ating Walo at maiparamdan sa kanila ang pagmamahal ng ating mga palangga! 

Para sa aming mga Bossing Palangga, maraming maraming salamat po sa walang sawang pagmamahal, pagtitiwala, at pag-suporta sa CFS para makapag-hatid ng saya at suporta Para sa BINI, Para sa Blooms, Para kay Colet! 

Para sa aming mga butihing VolunTEAM, Team Colet OFC, Team Colet BVT, Team Colet CPT, Coca-Colets, Blooms, aming mga Palangga, maraming salamat po sa walang sawang dedikasyon, pag-tulong, at pagmamahal Para kay Colet, para sa Walo 💚

Para sa Team Pasay City Hall, Pasay Traffic and Parking Management City, Pasay PNP Office, Pasay City Rescue Team, Pasay City Fire Department, Team MoCard Catering and Services, Team Mall of Asia Arena, Team Decal World PH, maraming maraming salamat po sa magandang serbisyo at tulong upang mapanatili ang isang ligtas, mapayaba, at masayang aktibidad na inihandog ng Team Colet. 

Para sa lahat ng bumubuo ng Team BINI PH, Team ABS-CBN Sponsorship Department, Team ABS-CBN and Management, maraming maraming salamat po lahat ng gabay at oportunidad na maging isa sa mga sponsors ng Here with You: BINI Homecoming Fan meet! Masayang masaya po si Coco at ang mga palangga na maki-bahagi sa pagpapadama ng pagmamahal para sa ating Walo! 

Para sa aming Palangga, @bini_colet, maraming salamat po ha? sa pagiging matatag, sa paniniwala, at sa walang sawang pagpapa-alala na sa pagiging pursigido, pagtitiwala sa sarili, at pasasalamat, kayang kaya matupad ng lahat. Maraming salamat sa pagiging inspirasyon at sa pagiging mabuti. Sana palagi mo na matandaan, Na Na Nandito lang kami para suportahan at mahalin ka at ang BINI! 

Pasa sa Walo, hinding hindi magsa-sawa ang inyong Blooms na iparamdam sa inyo ang pagmamahal na walang hinihinging kapalit; solido at totoo. 

Muli at palagi, Para BINI, Para sa Blooms, Para kay Colet! Maraming maraming salamat po sa pag-sama sa ating byahe! 

Malayo na ang narating at malayo pa po ang kayang marating at lalakbayin. Tara, mga Palangga! 

Ako po ito, si Coco mula sa Colet Fan Suporta, Ito ang aming kwentong Bloom, ikaw palangga? ano ang kwentong bloom mo po? 

i-#KwentoMoKayCoco naman 'yan! 🥰

#ParaPo? 
#ParaKayColet 
#BINI_Colet 
#ColetFanSuporta

[3:30PM] #AlausaIkeja #TrafficUpdate 

Steady movement is observed on Obafemi Awolowo Way, starting from the Coca-Cola junction, proceeding through Radio and Allen junctions, with traffic becoming busy around Balogun Street as vehicles approach the Olowu area due to significant turning activity.

 From Olowu towards the underpass, traffic flow is steady. On Lateef Jakande Road, movement is fast from the Coca-Cola junction, passing LTV8 and Daily Times, with increased activity near Cadbury due to alternation delays. 

 Beyond Cadbury, traffic is also picking up speed towards the Omole roundabout. Aromire Street is experiencing busy movement inbound Adeniyi and through to Akko Villa, though this is not currently causing alarm. 

Mobolaji Johnson Avenue has good traffic flow along its entire stretch, from the old Tollgate and 7up gate through BillingsWay to the Alausa intersection. Lastly, the access points to and from Dr. Nurudeen Olowopopo Drive connecting to Otedola under the bridge are also reporting good traffic flow. 

No impediments have been observed, and personnel remain on standby to address any traffic issues. 

#FollowLASTMA

Inauguration of Bronze Statue of Former Chief Minister Sri Konijeti Roshaiah at Old Ps Saifabad and Telangana Pradesh Congress Committee Meeting at Lb Stadium On 04-07-2025

In connection with the Inauguration of Bronze Statue of Former Chief Minister Sri Konijeti Roshaiah at old PS Saifabad and Telangana Pradesh Congress Committee meeting at LB Stadium on 04-07-2025, the following traffic arrangements will be made.

Inauguration of Bronze Statue of Former Chief Minister Sri Konijeti Roshaiah at Old Ps Saifabad On 04-07-2025 From 0800 hours onwards

DIVERSION POINTS:- 
https://t.co/WNSMkJixjJ Iqbal Minar: a). Traffic coming from Secretariat will not be allowed towards Old PS Saifabad and will be diverted towards Ravindra Bhatathi. b). Traffic coming from Ravindra Bharathi will not be allowed towards Old PS Saifabad and will be diverted towards Teluguthalli Junction. 

https://t.co/UF6h7wmKQ6 Old PS Saifabad: Traffic Coming from Nirankari Jn. will not be allowed towards Ravindra Bhatathi via HDFC will be diverted towards Iqabal Minar and Old Bridge Lakdikapul). 
 
TRAFFIC CONGESTION JUNCTIONS 
1)Old PS Saifabad and 2) Iqbal Minar, 3). VV Statue, 4). Masabtank Junction, 5). Ravindra Bharathi, 6). Teluguthalli Junction. 

Telangana Pradesh Congress Committee Meeting at Lb Stadium on 04.07.2025 At 13:00 Hours to 20:00 Hours

The traffic will be either stopped or diverted at the following places/routes on need basis:
1.Traffic coming from AR Petrol Pump Jn. (Public Gardens) towards BJR Statue will not be allowed and will be diverted at A.R. Petrol Pump towards Nampally.

2.Traffic coming from Basheerbagh towards A.R. Petrol Pump will not be allowed and will be diverted at BJR Statue towards, SBI, Abids- Nampally station road.  

3.Traffic coming from Sujatha School lane towards Khan Lateef Khan building will not be allowed and will be diverted at Sujatha School junction towards Nampally.  

Junctions to be avoided between 2 p.m. to 8 p.m. on 04.07.2025:  
VV Statue, Khairatabad flyover, Ambedkar Statue, Telugu Thalli, Iqbal Minar, Ravindra Bharathi, Hyderabad Traffic Police Junction, Basheerbagh, BJR Statue Circle, SBI Gunfoundry, Abids Circle, A.R. Petrol Pump (Public Gardens), Nampally, KLK Building, Liberty, Himayath Nagar, Assembly, MJ Market and Hyderguda. 

RTC Buses:  
The RTC Buses plying from Ravindra Bharathi towards BJR Statue should avoid L.B. Stadium main Gate i.e. in front of Khan Lateef Khan Building and take diversion at A.R. Petrol (Public Gardens) bunk towards Nampally.  

Commuters are appealed to follow traffic updates on our social media platform @ https://t.co/RMgFu4sqLB and @ HYDTP (X handle). In case of any emergency in travel, kindly call our Hyderabad Traffic Police Helpline 9010203626 for travel assistance.

All citizens are requested to make note of the above diversions and take alternate routes to reach your destinations and cooperate with the Hyderabad Traffic Police

[4:06PM] #EbuteEro #Apongbon #trafficUpdate 

 The CMS bridge towards the Offin Canal market is experiencing slow movement due to a high volume of vehicles, ongoing market activities, and frequent vehicular ingress and egress at the market. However, immediately after the Offin Canal market, the stretch leading to Ijora Olopa by the NEPA intersection is flowing well.

 Broad Street from the Apongbon underpass, connecting to the Offin Canal market and Olowogbowo, is also experiencing slow but steady movement due to market activities and the evening rush hour. Conversely, Eko Bridge by the NEPA intersection heading inward Apongbon reports good traffic flow. 

The descent from Eko Bridge inward towards CMS, passing Elegbeta Mini Stadium and connecting to the Ebute-Ero market, shows steady movement, with traffic from the Ebute-Ero exit also flowing smoothly towards Eko Bridge. 

Furthermore, the Ebute-Ero market route inbound to Leventist, via the UBA roundabout, and connecting to both inner and outer Marina, is also reporting good traffic flow. Currently, no major impediments have been reported, and personnel are visibly present to manage the traffic situation.

#FollowLASTMA

I would like to share the alert from Dr.Lawrence Peck.   

ALERT:  From July 25-27th in New York City, hardcore pro-North Korea activists from across the U.S, ROK & elsewhere will hold a major conference.  

REFER TO THE LINKS BELOW  The conference itself will be held at on July 25-26th at the Riverside Church in New York, site of so many extreme-left events for decades, and will culminate on the 27th with a protest rally, probably in front of the UN building, and possibly a march to UN Missions of the ROK and North Korea.  

A wide variety of openly pro-North Korea, pro-Chinese Communist Party, pro-Hamas, and other extremist groups and activists will participate. 

The pro-North Korean youth group NODUTDOL will be a main organizer of the conference, as well as groups which support terrorist organizations. Extremists from all over the U.S. and the ROK will attend, as well as activist from other countries.  

WOMEN CROSS DMZ will also actively participate.  This pro-North Korea "festival" has the fingerprints of the Singham network all over it!  Singham's pro-CCP network groups, such as The People's Forum, Party for Socialism and Liberation (ANSWER), and Code Pink will play key roles in this event, which leads to suspicions that it may be funded by the CCP.  

It will be the largest pro-North Korea conference held here for over 20 years!  The themes will be support for North Korea and "liberation" of the ROK.  

Some of the announced keynote speakers will be communist Brian Becker who leads the Party for Socialism and Liberation (ANSWER), Cathi Choi who is the new leader of WOMEN CROSS DMZ / Korea Peace Now, Ju-hyun Park of Nodutdol, Sara Flounders of the Workers World Party, and Vijay Prashad of the Tricontinental Institute.    

Prashad is directly involved with and a key figure in the CODE PINK/SINGHAM/CCP funding and political influence network.  

 In fact, CODE PINK is one of the sponsors of this conference.  Becker and his PSL / ANSWER are also involved with the Singham network.  

One of the other speakers is Manolo De Los Santos, the leader of The People's Forum, which has reportedly received millions from Singham.    

Also speaking will be someone named Tamar G. from the Palestinian Youth Movement, which has expressed support for U.S.-designated Foreign Terrorist Organizations such as the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine (PFLP), Hamas and the Islamic Republic of Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC).  

Another speaker is from Bayan, a front group for another U.S.-designated Terrorist Organization, the communist New People's Army of the Philippines.    

This pro-North Korea "festival" has the fingerprints of the Singham network all over it!   

This also demonstrates that Singham is very much interested in and funding pro-North Korea forces here!  

The sponsor Koreans for Woori Schools is the unofficial U.S. representative of and fundraiser for CHONGRYON of Japan, which is controlled by the North Korean government.    

The sponsor Action Committee for Sovereign Peaceful Reunification of Korea is the formerly named 6.15 Committee.    

They visit the North's UN Mission often and used to often visit the North, and they would regularly meet, as Christine Ahn did, with intelligence agents based at the North's UN Mission.    

The sponsor International Strategy Center, based in Seoul, is a pro-North group tied to the Venezuelan regime, and this means that activists from Korea will be participating in this conference.    

The sponsor Bronx Anti-War Coalition is noteworthy, not only because it is openly pro-CCP but also because it recently made a statement explicitly praising the murder of the two Israeli diplomats in D.C.    

This conference is shaping up to be a veritable "who's who" of the hardcore pro-North Korea movement!  It seems like "everyone who is anyone" in the pro-North Korea movement will be involved in it.  

Although there is no way to know in advance, and perhaps not likely, it is possible that North Korean intelligence agents from their UN Mission may attend.

For your safety, please avoid the area and take alternate routes.

Updates will be provided as they become available. Thank you for your patience.
